_source: Stock Unlimited, Lecture 2 'Data Correlation' (video 3). Edit thresholds here, not in code.

portfolio_stock_futures._rule: FII!AE (net stock futures). Start the portfolio when AE > entry; add 1/5 tranche for every +step; book part near partial; exit fully below exit; re-enter above entry again (0:00-9:24, 26:05-27:30, 30:14-31:21).
portfolio_stock_futures._scaled_note: His numbers date from 2021-22. FII stock-futures OI is ~5-10x larger since 2024, so the app also shows the same rule scaled by (rolling-250 median AE / 2021-22 median).

net_options_Y._rule: FII!Y net options. Below the line = bearish, above = bullish; believe it only after 2-3 days in a row (10:52-12:49). Lot size halved -> line doubles (24:47-25:33).
net_options_Y._lot_note: Dates are approximate; verify against NSE circulars. Used only for the lot-adjusted view.

put_call_short_AM._rule: FII!AM put short / call short. >1 = buy on dip. Use ~0.97 rather than 1, needs 2-3 days in a row; 2 days below 0.95 = bearish (9:48-10:36, 14:11-14:32).

all_three_above_1._rule: FII AM, PRO AB and Retail AI all > 1 for 2 days in a row -> market near a bottom, goes up (42:24-43:09).

pro_monday_short_covering._rule: Thursday-expiry era (2022): on Monday, PRO net CE (PRO!T = call long - call short) more negative than -2.6/-2.7 lakh -> Monday dips below Friday's high, then by expiry the market crosses Friday's high (short covering). Target = Friday high (46:25-52:31).

fii_pre_expiry_reversal._rule: Day before expiry (Wednesday then): FII added call long, cut call short, and added more put long than put short -> expiry day opens gap-up, then an engulfing red candle; buy puts after the gap-up, target below the pre-expiry low (52:31-56:05).

fii_vol_momentum._rule: FII Vol sheet: on expiry day, FII net CE vol (O) and net PE vol (P) both clearly negative -> next day has momentum; long straddle at open (after the first 15-min candle). Also: both negative on the two days before expiry and more negative on the second -> expiry-day momentum (56:12-1:03:24).
fii_vol_momentum._momentum_note: A day counts as 'momentum' when the biggest move away from the open (high-open or open-low) is at least this % of the open (~185 pts at 23,000), roughly what a long ATM straddle needs.

expiry_calendar._rule: Nifty weekly expiry weekday by period (0=Mon ... 3=Thu). A holiday moves it to the previous trading day.

outcome_scoring._note: Any bucket with fewer days is shown as INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE, never as a percentage.

paths._note: Dhan first (your Data API); yfinance only for dates before Dhan's intraday history.
